description: This PHP class 'EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' implements a menu configuration for the 'orangehrmAttendancePlugin'. It overrides module and screen identifiers for the attendance view as part of menu setup within the HRM system.

classes.name: EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the attendance menu for the current screen, overriding module and screen identifiers.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the current screen by overriding the module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewMyAttendanceRecord'.
